verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP and Autopilot features let AI surface themes and capture untracked feedback, and MCP can 'organize requests,' hinting at some automated linking, but there is no explicit documentation of AI automatically detecting insights and linking them to specific related feature ideas. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic duplicate/insight detection, explicit linking of feedback insights to existing roadmap ideas, and any hands-on validation of this specific workflow.
